# Geekboots

> > Geekboots is a technology publication covering web development, AI/ML applications, digital transformation, and developer resources.

Geekboots provides practical guides and insights on modern web technologies (React, Node.js, SASS/SCSS, WordPress), artificial intelligence implementations across industries, and resources for hiring remote developers. The site focuses on actionable content for developers, tech professionals, and businesses navigating digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- AI and Machine Learning
- Web Development
- Digital Transformation
- React and Node.js
- MERN Stack
- Remote Developer Hiring
- AI Content Moderation
- WordPress Optimization
- CSS Preprocessors (SASS/SCSS)
- IoT Applications
- Cloud Computing
- Natural Language Processing
- Nearshore Development
- Brand Protection
- Tech Recruitment
